lines.japanese: さて、昨日は遊びすぎちゃったから、今日は真面目に頑張ろう。
lines.english: Okay, I had too much fun yesterday, so time to buckle down and work.

lines.japanese: まあ最近玉泉をからかいすぎてたしね。やる気のあるところをアピールしておかないとね。
lines.english: Besides, I’d been teasing Tamaizumi too much lately. I needed to show I meant to work.

lines.japanese: よしっ、さあどんな指示でもがんがん来い！
lines.english: All right! Bring on the orders! Anything you've got!

lines.japanese: 「あの俺、なにすればいいですかね」
lines.english: “Um... What am I supposed to be doing?”

lines.japanese: 「は？　そんなのもう二週間もいるんだから空気読めてきたでしょ？　もし分からないなら担当に聞きなよ」
lines.english: “What? You've been here two weeks. Surely you can read the room by now. If you don't know, ask whoever's supervising you.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、もっともだ」
lines.english: “Yes. Fair point.”

lines.japanese: しかし時刻は１８時２０分。今日って玉泉は休みじゃない……よな？
lines.english: But it was 6:20. Tamaizumi wasn't off today... was she?

lines.japanese: まあ担当がいないと動けないってワケじゃないし、いざとなればその上の責任者のマスターに指示を仰げばいいんだけど……いつも着替えてすぐ玉泉に指示をもらいに行ってたから、なんかすっきりしないなあ。
lines.english: It's not like I couldn't get anything done without my supervisor. If I had to, I could always ask her boss, the manager, what to do... But I always changed and went straight to Tamaizumi for instructions, so it just felt weird.

lines.japanese: 「玉泉どしたんですかね。事故にでも遭ってないといいんですけど」
lines.english: “I wonder what happened to Tamaizumi. I hope she hasn't been in an accident.”

lines.japanese: 「いや千歳ぇ……」
lines.english: “Chitose...”

lines.japanese: 時計と入り口を交互に見比べていたら、英里子さんに呆れた顔をされてしまった。
lines.english: I kept looking from the clock to the entrance until Eriko gave me an exasperated look.

lines.japanese: 「おまえたまひよのことロボットみたいに思ってるかもしれないけど、あいつだって人間だからね？　寝坊することだって一年に一回くらいはあるよ」
lines.english: “Maybe you think Tama-chick’s a robot, but she’s human too, okay? Even she might oversleep once a year.”

lines.japanese: 「ええー、しないよあのひと。だっていっつも計ったように正確な時間に来るもん」
lines.english: “No way. Not her. She always arrives at exactly the same time, like clockwork.”

lines.japanese: 「バーカ、それは学校の帰りだからだよ。今日は土曜日じゃん、昨日の夜遅くまで男と電話して、夕方まで寝てるかもしれないよ」
lines.english: “Idiot, that's because she comes straight from school. It's Saturday. Maybe she was up late talking to a man and slept until evening.”

lines.japanese: 「男と電話……えっ、玉泉に彼氏いるの！？」
lines.english: “Talking to a man...? Tamaizumi has a boyfriend!?”

lines.japanese: 「いや知らないけど例え話だよ。たまひよ、黙ってりゃ顔はいいんだし、共学校なんだからオトコ出来てもおかしくないでしょ。美人、優秀、巨乳、逆に居ない方が不思議じゃない？」
lines.english: “I don't know. It was an example. Tama-chick's got a pretty face when she keeps quiet, and she goes to a coed school. It wouldn't be strange if she found a guy. Beautiful, smart, stacked—honestly, it'd be stranger if she didn't have one.”

lines.japanese: 「うわ、発想がおっさんくせえー」
lines.english: “Wow. You think like an old man.”

lines.japanese: 「ああん？　事実を認めたくないからって私に当たるなよ」
lines.english: “Huh? Don't take it out on me because you don't want to face the facts.”

lines.japanese: 「い、いや別に認めたくないってわけじゃ……」
lines.english: “N-no, it's not that I don't want to...”

lines.japanese: い、いや、確かに玉泉に五分の一ほど好意以上の感情を持っていたこともあるが、だって俺にはかわいい妹がいるし……あわわわ、なにナチュラルに妹をかわいいとか言ってるんだ俺。
lines.english: I-I mean, at one point, one fifth of me had felt something for Tamaizumi beyond simple fondness. But I had my adorable little sister... W-wait. Why was I casually calling my sister adorable?

lines.japanese: 「すみません！」
lines.english: “I’m sorry!”

lines.japanese: なんて一人でうにょうにょしていたら玉泉が駆けこんできた。よかった、事故じゃなかったみたいだ。
lines.english: While my thoughts tied themselves in knots, Tamaizumi came rushing in. Good. Apparently she hadn't been in an accident.

lines.japanese: 「おはよう玉泉、なかなか来ないからちょっと心配しちゃったぞ」
lines.english: “Morning, Tamaizumi. You weren't showing up, so I was starting to worry.”

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめんなさい！　その、寝坊しちゃってっ……！」
lines.english: “I-I'm sorry! I, um, overslept...!”

lines.japanese: え、寝坊？
lines.english: What? She had overslept?

lines.japanese: へえ、ほんとに英里子さんの言った通りだ。玉泉でも寝坊することなんてあるんだな。
lines.english: Huh. Eriko had been exactly right. Even Tamaizumi overslept sometimes.

lines.japanese: でもそんなこと言うと逆に気を使ってしまいそうなんで、あとのことは上に任せて黙っておいた。
lines.english: But saying so would probably make her even more self-conscious, so I left the rest to management and held my tongue.

lines.japanese: 「あー、いいよいいよ、早く着替えて来いって」
lines.english: “Ah, it's fine. Go get changed.”

lines.japanese: 「す、すみません、その、仕事で挽回しますから……」
lines.english: “I-I'm sorry. I'll make up for it with my work...”

lines.japanese: 「だーから気にしなくていいって。ほら店先でぺこぺこするな？」
lines.english: “I said don't worry about it. And quit bowing over and over at the entrance, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「すっ、すみません……」
lines.english: “I-I’m sorry...”

lines.japanese: んー……。
lines.english: Hmm...

lines.japanese: なんだか英里子さんの言う通りになったから、さっきの冗談も気になるなあ。玉泉に限ってそんなことないだろうけど……あれっ、でも、男友達が居ないなんて分かるわけないよな。なんで冗談だと思ってるんだ俺。
lines.english: Since Eriko had been right, her earlier joke began to bother me too. Surely not Tamaizumi... But wait. I had no way of knowing she didn't have male friends. Why had I assumed it was a joke?

lines.japanese: 「はは、昨日の夜に遅くまで電話でもしてたりしてー……」
lines.english: “Ha ha. Maybe you were on the phone late last night or something...”

lines.japanese: 冗談に紛らわせて言ってみたけど、ちょっと緊張した。
lines.english: I tried to pass the question off as a joke, but asking it made me oddly tense.

lines.japanese: 「あ、その……すみません、その通りです。昼間についウトウトしちゃって、起きたらこんな時間に……」
lines.english: “Um... I'm sorry. That's exactly what happened. I dozed off during the day, and when I woke up, it was already this late...”

lines.japanese: ええっ。
lines.english: What?

lines.japanese: 驚いてから、自分が驚いたことにビックリした。なんで驚いてるんだ俺。そりゃ五分の一がショック受けるのは分かるけど……。
lines.english: First I was shocked. Then I was shocked that I had been shocked. Why was I reacting this way? I understood why one fifth of me would feel wounded, but...

lines.japanese: 「へえ、どんな電話？」
lines.english: “Oh? What kind of call?”

lines.japanese: しかも追加で質問までしてしまった。くそ、なんで俺がこんな軟派なことを言わなくちゃいけないんだ。ブッ殺すぞ鷲ヤロウ。
lines.english: And then I asked a follow-up. Damn it. Why did I have to come out with something so flirtatious? I'll fucking kill you, Shusuke.

lines.japanese: 「えと、個人的な恋愛話なんで、あまり詳しくは言えませんけど、ちょっと揉めちゃって……」
lines.english: “Um, it concerns someone's private romantic affairs, so I can't say much. There was a bit of trouble...”

lines.japanese: 「恋愛話！」
lines.english: “Romantic affairs!”

lines.japanese: うそーん、玉泉に彼氏いたんだあ。あれあれー、落ちこむ必要ないぞ俺、だってかわいい妹いるじゃん。いや妹かわいくても関係ないだろ。
lines.english: No waaay. Tamaizumi had a boyfriend. Come on, no need to get depressed. You had an adorable little sister. No, having an adorable sister had nothing to do with this.

lines.japanese: 「なんだ玉泉君、そんな悩みがあるならばどうしてこの狩男に相談しない」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi, if you have troubles like these, why did you not consult Karuo?”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、店長……すみません、遅刻してしまいまして……」
lines.english: “Oh, Manager... I'm sorry. I was late...”

lines.japanese: 「そんなことはどうでもい……いや、原因は店長として聞いておくべきかもしれんな。さあどんな話をしていたのか、さわりだけでもいいから教えてよう」
lines.english: “That hardly mat—no. As manager, perhaps I ought to hear the cause. Come, tell me what you discussed. Just the gist will do.”

lines.japanese: そしてひとがさりげなくショックを受けてるときにこの男は……うう、もうこれ以上聞きたくないよう。
lines.english: And while a man was quietly reeling, this man had to... Ugh. I didn't want to hear any more.

lines.japanese: 「なになに、私にも聞かせてよ。相談乗るよ」
lines.english: “What, what? Let me hear too. I'll give you advice.”

lines.japanese: 「う、それなら仕方ありませんね……その、同じ学校のひとなんですけど、最近なかなか会えなくて寂しい思いをしてるんです」
lines.english: “If you insist... It's someone at my school. Lately they haven't been able to see each other much, and it's been terribly lonely.”

lines.japanese: 「なんと、女性に寂しい思いをさせるとはけしからん。一番最近会ったのはいつ頃なんだ」
lines.english: “Outrageous! No scoundrel should leave a woman to suffer such loneliness. When did they last meet?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、電車の中で触れあって抱きしめられたのが最後です」
lines.english: “Well, the last contact was on a train. They touched, and there was... an embrace.”

lines.japanese: <8>\「でででで電車の中で！」
lines.english: “O-on the train!?”

lines.japanese: がーん。この鉄壁防御（今日だってパンツスタイルだ）の玉泉の肌に触れた男がいるのかー。ううう、なんでか分からないけど悔しいなあ。
lines.english: That hit me like a hammer. Some man had touched the skin of ironclad Tamaizumi—she was wearing pants even today. Ugh. I didn't know why, but it was infuriating.

lines.japanese: 「なな、なんとけしからんやつだ、そんな真似までしておいて寂しい思いをさせるとは。その男とはいつから付きあっているんだ」
lines.english: “What an outrageous man! To go that far and then leave her lonely. How long have they been together?”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、付きあってはいません」
lines.english: “They aren't dating.”
“What!?”

lines.japanese: 「おおおおい聞いたか鷲介、俺は玉泉君を誤解していたようだ。貞操観念の固まりのようなことを言いつつ、付きあってもない男に肌を触れさせていたとはな。へへへ、こいつは見かけによらずエッチな女だぜ」
lines.english: “H-hey, Shusuke, did you hear that? I seem to have misunderstood Tamaizumi. She talks like chastity incarnate, yet she let a man touch her before they were even dating. Heh heh. She's naughtier than she looks.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ。なんでもいいですけど、無精ヒゲが当たるくらい顔を近付けないでください」
lines.english: “I don't particularly care, but please don't bring your face close enough for your stubble to scrape me.”

lines.japanese: 「ふん、玉泉君に幻想を抱いていたいのは分かるが、あいつはもう俺たちの知ってる女じゃねえ、とっくに雌色の下着をつけるお年頃になっていたのさ。たまらねえな、くくく」
lines.english: “Hmph. I know you want to preserve your fantasy of Tamaizumi, but she's not the woman we thought we knew. She's long since reached the age of wearing underwear that marks her as a female. Irresistible. Heh heh.”

lines.japanese: マスターは俺の頬におろし金をこすりつけると、一つ咳払いをして恭しく蝶ネクタイの位置を直した。
lines.english: Master ground the cheese grater of his cheek against mine, then cleared his throat and solemnly adjusted his bow tie.

lines.japanese: 「あー、あー」
lines.english: “Ahem. Ahem.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、玉泉君、君に大切な話がある。君はもう少し現実を直視して、そののちに視野を広げた方が良いという結論に達した」
lines.english: “Now then, Tamaizumi. I have something important to tell you. I have concluded that you should face reality more directly, and then broaden your horizons.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ……え、なにを唐突に？」
lines.english: “I see... Why this, all of a sudden?”

lines.japanese: 「よく周りを見てみたまえ、君のすぐ近くに君だけを見てくれる王子様がいるかもしれないぞ？」
lines.english: “Look around you carefully. Perhaps, very close at hand, there is a prince who has eyes only for you.”

lines.japanese: 何故か不気味な笑顔をうかべる３５歳。しかしその表情を見ることもなく、玉泉はゆっくりと首を回した。
lines.english: For some reason, the thirty-five-year-old wore an ominous smile. Without even looking at him, Tamaizumi slowly turned her head.

lines.japanese: 「すぐ近く……」
lines.english: “Very close...”

lines.japanese: その位置がある位置で止まり、涙目……いや泣いてない目の俺と視線がぶつかった。
lines.english: Her gaze stopped at one particular point and met my tearful—no, perfectly dry—eyes.

lines.japanese: 「千歳さんにはまず不真面目なところを直していただかないと……」
lines.english: “Chitose would first have to stop fooling around all the time...”

lines.japanese: え、俺？
lines.english: Me?

lines.japanese: ていうか直していただかないとって……いただいたらどうなるの？
lines.english: More to the point, she said I would have to stop... What would happen if I did?

lines.japanese: という間抜けた面をしていたら、マスターが俺の前に立ちはだかって首を横に振った。
lines.english: As I stood there looking witless, Master stepped between us and shook his head.

lines.japanese: 「違う、違うぞ玉泉君、もっと古い付きあいのひとがいるじゃないか」
lines.english: “No, no, Tamaizumi. There's someone you've known much longer.”

lines.japanese: 「鳳さんですか。まあ確かに容姿は整いすぎてるくらい綺麗ですが、いかんせんその他の部分に何一つ魅力を感じません」
lines.english: “Mr. Ohtori? His face is almost too beautiful, I’ll grant you, but I don’t find a single other thing about him attractive.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、それよりももっと前だ玉泉君。アレキサンダーに来てから、君のことをずっと見守ってきた年上のひとだ」
lines.english: “S-someone from even earlier, Tamaizumi. An older man who has watched over you ever since you came to Alexander.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 少し傾げた首が俺の隣のひとを見たとき、玉泉はなにかに気づいて少し困ったような表情を浮かべた。
lines.english: Her head tilted slightly. When she looked toward the person beside me, understanding dawned, followed by a mildly troubled expression.

lines.japanese: 「あの、性格には憧れる部分もありますし、頼れるひとではあるんですけど、さすがに英里子さんは女性なので……」
lines.english: “Well, there are aspects of her character I admire, and she is very dependable, but Eriko is a woman...”

lines.japanese: 「なぜ俺を避けるんだ！」
lines.english: “Why do you keep avoiding me!?”

lines.japanese: 「つーかたまひよ、さっきから言ってるのってさあ、みさきちの話だろ？」
lines.english: “More importantly, Tama-chick, you've been talking about Misa this whole time, right?”

lines.japanese: 仁王立ちつくすマスターをぐいと押しのけて英里子さんが前に出た。ん？　みさきち？
lines.english: Eriko shoved aside Master, who stood planted like a guardian statue, and stepped forward. Hm? Misa?

lines.japanese: 「はい、そうです。昨日も夜の３時まで……今日話を聞くって言ってるのに、さっきも昼の３時まで延々と……」
lines.english: “Yes. Last night it went on until three in the morning... Then even though I promised to hear her out today, she kept going again until three this afternoon...”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、みさきちも相変わらずだねえ」
lines.english: “Ahaha. Misa never changes.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、えーと……みさきちとは？」
lines.english: “Um... Who is Misa?”

lines.japanese: 「ん？　ああたまひよのクラスメイト。もう二年半くらい片思いしてるんだっけ？」
lines.english: “Hm? Oh, one of Tama-chick's classmates. She's been nursing an unrequited love for about two and a half years, hasn't she?”

lines.japanese: 「はい。もう今日も結論が出ないくせに同じことを何度も……でも最終的には前向きだから応援はしてるんです」
lines.english: “Yes. Even today, she repeated the same things over and over without reaching a conclusion... But she eventually manages to end on a positive note, so I support her.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、そうなんだあ……」
lines.english: “Oh. I see...”

lines.japanese: 「あ！　もう１０分も過ぎてる……す、すみません、すぐに着替えてきます！」
lines.english: “Ah! More than ten minutes have passed... I-I'm sorry. I'll change immediately!”

lines.japanese: 「いってらっしゃい」
lines.english: “Off you go.”

lines.japanese: 「ごゆっくりー」
lines.english: “Take all the time you need.”

lines.japanese: 手をひらひらと振りながら、安心してしまってる俺がいた。ああこれって不純だよなあ……。
lines.english: I gave her a lazy wave, relieved despite myself. Man, that's kind of impure of me...

lines.japanese: って不純じゃねえよ、だって小鳩は妹であって、別に俺が誰と恋愛しても自由じゃん。
lines.english: Wait, no, it isn't! Kobato's my sister, so I'm free to fall in love with whoever I want.

lines.japanese: さ、いつまでもアホなこと考えてないで仕事しよ仕事。
lines.english: Enough idiotic thoughts. Time to work.

lines.japanese: ぐい。
lines.english: A tug.

lines.japanese: そんな仕事に向かおうとした俺をつかむ腕一つ。
lines.english: As I tried to get back to work, an arm seized me.

lines.japanese: <6>\「どうして俺じゃダメなんだ！」
lines.english: “Why am I not good enough!?”

lines.japanese: 「知らんわ！」
lines.english: “How should I know!?”

lines.japanese: さてもう夜遅い時間ではあるんだが、電話してみよう。
lines.english: It was already late at night, but I decided to try calling.

lines.japanese: 俺は携帯電話を取りだして『君のためなら死ねる』フォルダに登録してある番号を呼びだした。
lines.english: I took out my phone and brought up the number saved in the folder titled *I'd Die for You*.

lines.japanese: ぷっ　ぷっ　ぷっ　ぷっ
lines.english: Beep. Beep. Beep. Beep.

lines.japanese: ぷるるるるっ……
lines.english: Rrrring...

lines.japanese: 「へーい、俺でぃーす」
lines.english: “Heeey, 'tis meee.”

lines.japanese: 「森里君！？　俺だよ、タカシだよ！　お願いだよ、話を聞いてよ！」
lines.english: “Morisato!? It's me, Takashi! Please, listen to me!”

lines.japanese: 「あー、はいはい……つかおまえさ、タカシじゃないんだろ？」
lines.english: “Yeah, yeah... But you're not Takashi, are you?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　いや、タカシだけど……」
lines.english: “What? No, I am Takashi...”

lines.japanese: 「いいよ。俺、翔さんから聞いておまえらの状況知ってるしさ。成田もタカシもガルーダも、全部一緒くたになったんだろ？」
lines.english: “It's fine. Kakeru told me. I know what's going on with you guys. Narita, Takashi, Garuda—you all got rolled into one, right?”
“Oh. Yes...”

lines.japanese: なんだ森里君は全部知っちゃったのか。
lines.english: So Morisato knew everything now.

lines.japanese: 実のところその覚悟はついていた。森里君は一年の時の同級生だし、フレイムバーズとして隼人だった俺とも会ってる。気づかないはずがないし、今まで何も言ってこなかったってことは、すべて知ってるってことだ。
lines.english: In truth, I had prepared myself for that. He was my classmate in our first year, and he had also met Hayato—me—as a member of the Flame Birds. There was no way he could fail to notice. The fact that he had said nothing until now meant he knew it all.

lines.japanese: 「まあそういうことなんだよね……はは」
lines.english: “Well, yes. That's more or less it... Ha ha.”

lines.japanese: 「つか分かんねえなあ、おまえさ、なんでタカシの時の自分で俺と話そうとするわけ？」
lines.english: “What I don't get is why you're trying to talk to me as Takashi.”

lines.japanese: 「ん、なにが？」
lines.english: “Hm? What do you mean?”

lines.japanese: 「だっておまえ、俺と話すのにもっと便利な人格いっぱいあるじゃん。なんでタカシのときのものなのよ」
lines.english: “You've got plenty of personalities that'd be more convenient for talking to me. Why come at me in Takashi mode?”

lines.japanese: 「べつに俺だって選んで話してるわけじゃないよ」
lines.english: “I don't get to choose which version of me does the talking.”

lines.japanese: 森里君の言いたいことは分かる。それはもしかしたら、自分がタカシに接してた時の反動から俺のことを恐れてるのかもしれないけど、たぶん彼が一番戸惑ってるんじゃないかと思う。
lines.english: I understood what Morisato meant. Perhaps he was afraid of me because of how he had treated Takashi. More than that, though, I suspected he was the most bewildered person of all.

lines.japanese: タカシとしての俺と、隼人としての俺という、とくに両極端な性格のふたりと密接に関わってきたのは、小鳩を除いては彼一人と言っていい。
lines.english: Apart from Kobato, he might be the only person who had known both of my most extreme selves intimately: the me who was Takashi and the me who was Hayato.

lines.japanese: 俺は朝起きたら目を開くようにして自然と接せられたけど、森里君にはどんな風に見えてるんだろう。
lines.english: Talking to him had always felt as natural to me as opening my eyes in the morning. But what did I look like to Morisato?

lines.japanese: 「なんていうか、長く接してきた話し方が自然に出ちゃうんだよ。だって森里君は三年間ずっと俺の友達でいてくれたから……」
lines.english: “I don’t know. The way I’ve talked to you all these years just comes out on its own. You stayed my friend for three whole years...”

lines.japanese: 「友達っ！」
lines.english: “Friend!?”

lines.japanese: 電話の向こうでかかかと笑い声が聞こえた。なんだか背中に手のひらサイズの熱さが広がった。
lines.english: His sharp cackle came through the phone. A patch of warmth the size of my palm spread across my back.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、キメーこと言うなって！　んーな、初対面のやつに友達とか言われても、俺だってなんつっていいか分かんねーもん」
lines.english: “Don't say creepy shit like that! If some guy I've never even met calls me his friend, I don't know what the hell I'm supposed to say.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、確かに……俺、タカシじゃないし隼人でもないしなあ」
lines.english: “Ah. True... I'm not Takashi, and I'm not Hayato either.”

lines.japanese: 「だろ？　なんだっけ、俺おまえの名前もよく覚えてねーし」
lines.english: “Right? Hell, I don't even remember your name properly.”

lines.japanese: 「ヨージ。羽田ヨージって言うんだけど……」
lines.english: “Yoji. My name is Yoji Haneda...”

lines.japanese: 「ああそう」
lines.english: “Oh. Right.”

lines.japanese: 電話の向こうからため息がひとつ聞こえた。でも不思議と寂しさも悔しさも感じない呼吸音だ。
lines.english: A sigh came through the phone. Strangely, it carried neither loneliness nor frustration.

lines.japanese: 「ま、だからなんつーか……」
lines.english: “Well, so... I mean...”

lines.japanese: 「あー、なんだろな。なんつんだろーなコレ」
lines.english: “Ah, what is it? What do you even call this?”

lines.japanese: 「つーか、今さらこんなん言うのも恥ずかしいんですけどー」
lines.english: “I mean, it's kind of embarrassing to say this now...”

lines.japanese: つーか、何回つーか言ってんだおまえ。俺は病院の屋上でひとり、あのにやけた面が斜め上に視線を泳がせているのを想像して、軽く吹きだした。
lines.english: How many times was he going to say *I mean*? I pictured him alone on the hospital roof, that grinning face turned up and his eyes wandering off to one side, and let out a small laugh.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、今から病院来られる？」
lines.english: “Can you come to the hospital now?”

lines.japanese: 「うん！」
lines.english: “Yes!”

lines.japanese: あのうざったいロンゲ。どう考えても切った方がいいと思うけど、今日はなんだか許せるような気になった。
lines.english: That obnoxious long hair. However I looked at it, he really ought to cut it. But today, somehow, I felt I could almost forgive it.

lines.japanese: 気になっただけだから、会ってすぐ「髪切った方がいいよ」って言っちゃうと思うけど。
lines.english: I only felt that way, mind you. The moment we met, I would probably tell him, 'You should cut your hair.'

lines.japanese: 俺は８０円のブルガリを両手にひとつずつ持って、親友を待たせないため全速力で駆けていった。
lines.english: With an eighty-yen ‘Bulgari’ in each hand, I ran flat out so I would not keep my best friend waiting.
